verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bento has general AI capabilities (natural-language building via docs-10, MCP/CLI for account management) but nothing documents an in-composer AI feature that drafts or refines email subject lines or body copy from a marketer's brief. Broadcasts, sequences, and templates docs (bento-docs-34, 37, 43) describe structure but never mention AI-assisted copywriting inside the email editor.
